prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='CWT_rf', seasonality_champion='NaiveMovingAverage', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: Trend champion CWT_rf achieves perfect correlation (1.0) with y_true trend, while seasonality champion NaiveMovingAverage leads with 0.4891 correlation. DWT_catboost wins overall RMSE (415.60) but trend/seasonality champions split across different models. With rmse_spread_ratio=7.62, unstable rankings (Kendall=-0.02), and concept drift detected, STL-hierarchical stacking is recommended to exploit decomposition-aware combination while handling model disagreement and drift.
